positive_findings: U_update preserves the branch set and explicitly avoids automatic resolution.
D_resolve preserves alternatives rather than deleting losing branches.
canonical-truth, direct-effect, runtime-credit and training-credit outputs are fail-closed false.
same provenance ancestry is at least partially recognized as non-independent.
salience ranking is explicitly separated from truth, probability and evidence strength.
the source tests cover branch preservation, duplicate ancestry, no-discriminator unresolved behavior, task-local resolution, ordinal discriminator ranking and truth-authority leakage.

material_blockers.finding: U_update receives effect=SUPPORT/WEAKEN/FALSIFY/PROVE/RETAIN from the caller and does not derive that effect from branch semantics plus the observation. A caller-provided PROVE can therefore set PROVEN_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD without a proof relation being computed by the labeler.
material_blockers.why_it_matters: This moves the missing label one field upstream rather than constructing a correct target state. D/E training labels remain circular if the generator invents effect metadata.
material_blockers.required_successor: Derive update effects from an executable task-world relation/proof evaluator or bind the effect to a separately verified deterministic derivation receipt; never trust model-visible or generator-asserted effect labels as the ground truth source.

material_blockers.finding: D_resolve trusts winner_branch_id and separates_live_branch_ids supplied by discriminator_outcome. It verifies set membership but does not derive the winner or separation from branch predictions and observed discriminator results.
material_blockers.why_it_matters: A syntactically complete discriminator object can manufacture resolution labels without demonstrating discriminating evidence.
material_blockers.required_successor: Represent each live branch's predicted discriminator outcome and compute partition/separation plus winner consistency from the observed result.

material_blockers.finding: D_resolve does not require discriminator_outcome.admissible == true. A discriminator marked inadmissible can still resolve when its declared winner and separation set pass the current checks.
material_blockers.required_successor: Fail closed on inadmissible discriminators before any resolution path.

material_blockers.finding: U_update requires evidence.independence_group but never uses it. Two items with different provenance_ancestry_id but the same declared dependence group are currently treated as independent updates.
material_blockers.why_it_matters: This violates the current Goodman/provenance-independence law and can double-count correlated evidence.
material_blockers.required_successor: Collapse duplicate/correlated evidence by both causal/provenance ancestry and an explicit independently-derived dependence-group identity.

material_blockers.finding: The updater does not fail closed on replay of the same evidence_id under altered ancestry metadata. Same-ancestry detection is branch-local and does not establish global causal-event uniqueness.
material_blockers.required_successor: Bind evidence_id to immutable provenance/causal identity and reject contradictory replay identity before applying an update.

material_blockers.finding: The current test source does not exercise inadmissible-discriminator resolution, same-independence-group/different-ancestry evidence, forged PROVE effects, altered-ancestry evidence replay, branch-permutation invariance or derivation-from-task-world semantics.
material_blockers.required_successor: Add mutation/regression tests for every blocker before changing the artifact status.

external_research_delta.source: arXiv:2305.08298 Symbol tuning improves in-context learning in language models
external_research_delta.training_implication: Arbitrary/flipped symbol-label mappings are useful pressure toward reading episode-local mappings instead of memorizing semantic label priors; this supports the binder curriculum but does not prove a specific Qwen mechanism.

external_research_delta.source: arXiv:2505.20896 How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_research_delta.training_implication: Systematic variable binding/routing can emerge under training and can be studied causally; use as mechanism plausibility, not as positive evidence for the selected Qwen checkpoint.

Abstractive ICL can persist when copy-predictable-token training pressure is suppressed, so the curriculum must target behavioral invariants and not hard-code classic induction-copy heads as a necessary mechanism.

external_research_delta.source: arXiv:2405.15071 Grokked Transformers are Implicit Reasoners
external_research_delta.training_implication: Reasoning generalization may emerge late and differ sharply by reasoning type; C must be tracked on frozen OOD/depth/vocabulary curves through training rather than stopped at train-loss convergence.

external_research_delta.source: ACL 2024: Explore Spurious Correlations at the Concept Level in Language Models for Text Classification (arXiv:2311.08648)
external_research_delta.training_implication: Counterfactual rebalancing can mitigate concept-label shortcuts; this independently supports the current full-cross and nuisance-challenger strategy.

external_research_delta.source: ACL 2025: Alleviating Hallucinations from Knowledge Misalignment in Large Language Models via Selective Abstention Learning
external_research_delta.training_implication: Explicit abstention objectives can teach selective rejection; supports treating UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN as a first-class E/GRF behavior while still requiring project-specific epistemic labels and calibration.
